ValidationRule.description: #27543 : Account Coverage fields are not allowed to edit on Sales Site Account #34421: Added AMD and RIM SDE #34453 : Account: Update Account Segmentation for '26 GTM - PLNI0014642 #34498: Sector field can only be updated when Hierarchy Level = IMGA
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Account'))),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)'), ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Tele_CDE__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Information_Governance_Rep__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(DMS_Owner__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(DM_Cloud_Sales_Rep__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Primary_BDE__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Enterprise_ISR__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Primary_Local_Market_Rep_1__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Data_Centre_Owner__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Library_Services_BDE__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(IM_Territories__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(AMD__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(RIM_SDE__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Text(Sector__c))), Strategic_Account__c, NOT(ISBLANK(WL_Owner__c)) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Sales (Site)'), OR( ISCHANGED(Tele_CDE__c), ISCHANGED(Information_Governance_Rep__c), ISCHANGED(DMS_Owner__c), ISCHANGED(DM_Cloud_Sales_Rep__c), ISCHANGED(Primary_BDE__c), ISCHANGED(Enterprise_ISR__c), ISCHANGED(Primary_Local_Market_Rep_1__c), ISCHANGED(Data_Centre_Owner__c), ISCHANGED(Library_Services_BDE__c), ISCHANGED(IM_Territories__c), ISCHANGED(AMD__c), ISCHANGED(RIM_SDE__c), ISCHANGED(Sector__c), PRIORVALUE(Strategic_Account__c)!= Strategic_Account__c, ISCHANGED(WL_Owner__c) ) ), /* ---Block Sector on Create of CP Account---*/ AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Country Parent'), Industry_Override__c = False, ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(Text(Sector__c))) ), /* ---Block Sector on Edit of CP Account---*/ AND( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c,'Country Parent'), Industry_Override__c = False, ISCHANGED(Sector__c) ) ), $User.UITheme <>'Theme2', $User.UITheme <> 'Theme3' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account Coverage, Segmentation & Territory fields can only be set at the IMGA or Country Parent Account
